fields.subject: Shard Set Fan-Out
fields.trigger: while a read-first call is still waiting for a non-null result, one of the not-yet-resolved per-shard read tasks completes faulted or cancelled
fields.response: the failure is recorded and the wait continues with the remaining target shards; if another shard then produces a non-null result, that result is returned and every recorded or later shard failure is ignored
fields.postcondition: a shard failure surfaces only when no targeted shard produced a non-null result and the caller has not cancelled: a single recorded failure is rethrown as-is, with its original exception type, and several are rethrown together as an AggregateException; if the caller's token was cancelled, OperationCanceledException is thrown instead of any shard failure

sources.label: ThrowFailures: one failure as-is, several as AggregateException
